content.about.label: 01 // ABOUT AUTONOMOUS
content.about.title: Una empresa moldeada por una creencia simple.
content.about.p1: AUTONOMOUS representa el compromiso con la próxima generación de experiencias inteligentes de IA y automatización. Nuestra dirección es clara: construir sistemas que simplifiquen los retos cotidianos y ayuden a las personas a centrarse en lo importante.
content.about.p2: Intelligent technology matters because time and attention are the most valuable resources people have. Every repetitive task that a machine can carry out carefully and reliably is an opportunity for a person to create, decide and achieve more.
content.about.p3: Our approach to innovation is deliberate. We explore, plan and build with care — preferring useful, dependable technology over novelty for its own sake.
content.about.p4: Our long-term direction is an ecosystem of intelligent agents that work alongside people. The journey has begun, and it will unfold step by step.
content.about.problems_title: The problems we want to address
about.problems: Repetitive manual effort that consumes time and energy.
Complex tools that add friction instead of removing it.
Technology that demands attention instead of giving it back.
content.about.approach_body: We start from real human needs, keep what we build simple and useful, and refine continuously. We are building toward a future where technology becomes more capable, adaptive and useful.
content.vision.label: 02 // OUR VISION
content.vision.title: Construir un ecosistema de agentes de IA inteligentes que simplifiquen la vida y el trabajo.
content.vision.body: We imagine technology that understands context, acts with care and gives people back their time. Our vision guides every decision: intelligent systems that simplify life and work, quietly and dependably.
content.mission.label: 03 // OUR MISSION
content.mission.title: Cuatro principios guían nuestro trabajo.
content.mission.intro: Our mission is to create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.mission.item1_body: Develop intelligent technologies that automate repetitive tasks.
content.mission.item2_title: Ayudar a trabajar con más inteligencia

content.mission.item4_body: Create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.philosophy.label: 04 // OUR PHILOSOPHY
content.philosophy.title: Intelligence in service of people.
content.philosophy.quote: La tecnología no debería solo hacer que las personas trabajen más rápido. Debería ayudarles a lograr mejores resultados.
content.philosophy.p1: We believe the future of technology lies in intelligent collaboration between humans and machines. Machines contribute speed, memory and consistency; people contribute judgment, creativity and purpose.
content.philosophy.p2: Empowerment, usefulness and simplicity are our measures of success. Responsible innovation is our obligation: we build carefully, honestly and with respect for the people who will rely on what we make.
content.exploring.label: 05 // WHAT WE'RE EXPLORING
content.exploring.title: Cuatro direcciones, una ambición.
content.exploring.intro: We are exploring the building blocks of an intelligent future. Each area is a piece of the same puzzle.

content.hero.intro: Ein aufstrebendes Technologieunternehmen, das neue Möglichkeiten in intelligenter KI und Automatisierung erforscht.
content.hero.believe: Wir glauben, dass Technologie mehr tun sollte, damit Menschen mehr erreichen können.

content.about.label: 01 // ABOUT AUTONOMOUS
content.about.title: Ein Unternehmen, geprägt von einem einfachen Glauben.
content.about.p1: AUTONOMUS steht für die nächste Generation intelligenter KI- und Automatisierungserlebnisse. Unsere klare Richtung: Systeme bauen, die Alltagsherausforderungen vereinfachen und Menschen helfen, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.
content.about.p2: Intelligent technology matters because time and attention are the most valuable resources people have. Every repetitive task that a machine can carry out carefully and reliably is an opportunity for a person to create, decide and achieve more.
content.about.p3: Our approach to innovation is deliberate. We explore, plan and build with care — preferring useful, dependable technology over novelty for its own sake.
content.about.p4: Our long-term direction is an ecosystem of intelligent agents that work alongside people. The journey has begun, and it will unfold step by step.
content.about.problems_title: The problems we want to address
about.problems: Repetitive manual effort that consumes time and energy.
Complex tools that add friction instead of removing it.
Technology that demands attention instead of giving it back.
content.about.approach_body: We start from real human needs, keep what we build simple and useful, and refine continuously. We are building toward a future where technology becomes more capable, adaptive and useful.
content.vision.label: 02 // OUR VISION
content.vision.title: Ein Ökosystem intelligenter KI-Agenten aufbauen, das Leben und Arbeit vereinfacht.
content.vision.body: We imagine technology that understands context, acts with care and gives people back their time. Our vision guides every decision: intelligent systems that simplify life and work, quietly and dependably.
content.mission.label: 03 // OUR MISSION
content.mission.title: Vier Prinzipien leiten unsere Arbeit.
content.mission.intro: Our mission is to create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.mission.item1_body: Develop intelligent technologies that automate repetitive tasks.
content.mission.item2_body: Build AI agents that help people work smarter, save time and achieve more.
content.mission.item3_body: Explore autonomous systems that transform how individuals and businesses interact with technology.
content.mission.item4_body: Create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.philosophy.label: 04 // OUR PHILOSOPHY
content.philosophy.title: Intelligence in service of people.
content.philosophy.quote: Technologie sollte Menschen nicht nur schneller arbeiten lassen. Sie sollte ihnen helfen, bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
content.philosophy.p1: We believe the future of technology lies in intelligent collaboration between humans and machines. Machines contribute speed, memory and consistency; people contribute judgment, creativity and purpose.
content.philosophy.p2: Empowerment, usefulness and simplicity are our measures of success. Responsible innovation is our obligation: we build carefully, honestly and with respect for the people who will rely on what we make.
content.exploring.label: 05 // WHAT WE'RE EXPLORING
content.exploring.title: Vier Richtungen, ein Ehrgeiz.
content.exploring.intro: We are exploring the building blocks of an intelligent future. Each area is a piece of the same puzzle.
content.exploring.item1_body: Systems that understand context and adapt to the way people actually live and work.
content.exploring.item2_body: Technology that can carry out multi-step work with care, reliability and oversight.
content.exploring.item3_body: Interfaces where people and intelligent systems strengthen each other's strengths.
content.exploring.item4_body: Reducing repetitive manual effort so people can focus on what matters.

content.product.title: Etwas anderes entsteht.
content.product.intro: Deep in our workshop, a new kind of intelligent companion is taking form — assembled with patience, care and a bias for usefulness. We are not ready to share its name or its nature yet.

content.about.title: شركة تشكّلها قناعة بسيطة.
content.about.p1: تمثل AUTONOMOUS التزامًا بالجيل التالي من تجارب الذكاء الاصطناعي والأتمتة. اتجاهنا واضح: بناء أنظمة تبسّط تحديات الحياة اليومية وتساعد الناس على التركيز على ما يهم.
content.about.p2: Intelligent technology matters because time and attention are the most valuable resources people have. Every repetitive task that a machine can carry out carefully and reliably is an opportunity for a person to create, decide and achieve more.
content.about.p3: Our approach to innovation is deliberate. We explore, plan and build with care — preferring useful, dependable technology over novelty for its own sake.
content.about.p4: Our long-term direction is an ecosystem of intelligent agents that work alongside people. The journey has begun, and it will unfold step by step.
content.about.problems_title: The problems we want to address
about.problems: Repetitive manual effort that consumes time and energy.
Complex tools that add friction instead of removing it.
Technology that demands attention instead of giving it back.
content.about.approach_body: We start from real human needs, keep what we build simple and useful, and refine continuously. We are building toward a future where technology becomes more capable, adaptive and useful.
content.vision.label: 02 // OUR VISION
content.vision.title: بناء منظومة من وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي تبسّط الحياة والعمل.
content.vision.body: We imagine technology that understands context, acts with care and gives people back their time. Our vision guides every decision: intelligent systems that simplify life and work, quietly and dependably.
content.mission.label: 03 // OUR MISSION
content.mission.title: أربعة مبادئ توجّه عملنا.
content.mission.intro: Our mission is to create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.mission.item1_body: Develop intelligent technologies that automate repetitive tasks.
content.mission.item2_title: مساعدة الناس على العمل بذكاء أكبر
content.mission.item2_body: Build AI agents that help people work smarter, save time and achieve more.
content.mission.item3_body: Explore autonomous systems that transform how individuals and businesses interact with technology.
content.mission.item4_body: Create useful technology that empowers people rather than unnecessarily complicating their lives.
content.philosophy.label: 04 // OUR PHILOSOPHY
content.philosophy.title: Intelligence in service of people.
content.philosophy.quote: ينبغي ألا تقتصر مهمة التكنولوجيا على جعل الناس أسرع في العمل، بل مساعدتهم على تحقيق نتائج أفضل.
content.philosophy.p1: We believe the future of technology lies in intelligent collaboration between humans and machines. Machines contribute speed, memory and consistency; people contribute judgment, creativity and purpose.
content.philosophy.p2: Empowerment, usefulness and simplicity are our measures of success. Responsible innovation is our obligation: we build carefully, honestly and with respect for the people who will rely on what we make.
content.exploring.label: 05 // WHAT WE'RE EXPLORING
content.exploring.title: أربعة اتجاهات، طموح واحد.
content.exploring.intro: We are exploring the building blocks of an intelligent future. Each area is a piece of the same puzzle.

content.about.label: 01 // ABOUT AUTONOMOUS
content.about.title: A company shaped by a simple belief.

We are an emerging technology company with a clear direction: build systems that simplify everyday challenges, reduce repetitive manual effort and help people focus on what matters.
